as_told.title: Legacy programs used nuclear material as bait for UFOs

plain: Secret US government UFO projects that have run for decades, which insiders call legacy programmes, are said to have used real nuclear material, or sometimes fake nuclear material, as bait to make UFOs show up. Michels says this in an episode about UFOs seen near nuclear bases, and he credits it to Garry Nolan, a Stanford microbiologist. In that version the practice reaches beyond the US to Russia and runs from the middle of the century into the 1990s. If true, it would mean these programmes believed UFOs are drawn to nuclear material and used that to study them.
